note: Verification could not be completed: search infrastructure failed during this run (DuckDuckGo/searx returned 'Connection refused', Google returned HTTP 429, Bing returned only generic unrelated results for 'Micro Plastics'), and every shipment-data source (ImportKey, Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo) was either paywalled with zero visible rows or HTTP 403. No export shipment (date/destination/HS/B-L) and no domestic supply record (GST band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract) was confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in any source reached; not invented). Note the declared HS 950300 (toys) is consistent with the company name 'Toys and Engineering', but per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground and no HS correction is warranted on the evidence available. The claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) appears inconsistent with a toys/plastics manufacturer — flag for the desk, but this is a classification question, not a shipment finding. Recommended next step: re-run with working search, or query paid Volza/Eximpedia accounts directly for 'MICRO PLASTICS' Mumbai, and check GST portal / GeM for the exact legal name 'MPLASTICS TOYS AND ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED'.
